newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT rises on foreign investor interest.
newsitem.headline: PT rises on foreign investor interest.

text.p: Foreign investors are showing renewed interest in Portugal Telecom (PT), pushing up its share price, dealers said.

"A lot of foreign investors had sold PT in order to buy Deutsche Telecom and Spain's Telefonica, but now that they have completed their strategies for these stocks, they are returning to PT attracted by its healthy fundamentals," said one operator.
Another operator said: "PT's decision on a strategic partner to be announced soon is also stimulating buying interest."
PT is searching for a foreign partner to prepare for a liberalised telecommunications market.
PT stood at 4,166 escudos, up 16, in heavy volume of 316,586 shares at 1616 GMT. PT traded in a range between 4,135 and 4,179 escudos today.
